Specialty pizzas list at $21.95, which is the 10" small on Toast; the 12", 14" and 18" sizes are +$9.50, +$14.70 and +$20.70, so those are shown in desc and $21.95 is marked "from". BYO and Half & Half start at 14"; cheese sticks and wings show $0.00 base on Toast with a required size, so the smallest size price is used as "from".
Some pizzas (Butter Chicken, Lamb Kebab, Halal Chicken Tikka and others) have an optional Toast add-on called "Halal" at +$2/$3/$4/$5 by size; not listed as separate items.
